label: Hume pushed empiricism to skeptical conclusions regarding causality, induction, and the self
description: David Hume adopted George Berkeley's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from George Berkeley's perspective to David Hume's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Early Modern & Scientific across history into the Enlightenment & Social Contract.
